Name: VPR Letters (For Reshade Presets or Vanilla)
Author: xiaoleiwen
Description:
An amateurish recolor for the vanilla letters, suitable to be used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR) [/url] or for vanilla color game, and may reduce the wash-out effect (too bright) when using a Reshade preset.

I made this for own use when playing with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17242]Vintage Reshade[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20676]Caramel Reshade[/url]﻿, so that the letters look similar to VPR color tone under the Reshade effects, and it should look decent for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16398]Cinematic Reshade[/url] as well.

Just add this MOD to your [b]Mods folder[/b].
